ingredients.name: red or green chile pepper, seeded and chopped

steps.instruction: Lay the mango on its side and cut a slit across its tip.
Stand the mango on its stem end and slice off one side of the stone.
steps.spoken: Hold the mango upright on its stem end. Slice the flesh, with the skin still on, off one side of the stone, as close to the stone as you can.

steps.instruction: Turn the mango around and slice the flesh off the other side.
Set each half skin-side down and cut a criss-cross pattern in the flesh.
steps.spoken: Set each mango half skin-side down. Cut lines through the flesh, down to the skin, in a criss-cross pattern, to make 1/2-inch squares.

steps.instruction: Hold a half with your thumbs on the flesh and fingers under the skin.
Push the skin inside out with your fingers, so the cubes stand out.
Cut the cubes off the skin with a sharp knife.
Put the mango cubes in a small bowl.
Add 1 chopped red or green chile pepper and 1 teaspoon of chopped cilantro or mint.
Add 1/8 teaspoon of cayenne pepper and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 2 tablespoons of fresh orange juice.
steps.spoken: Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of fresh orange juice, or a mix of orange and lime juice.

steps.instruction: Chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Makes about 12 ounces.
steps.spoken: Chill in the refrigerator for 1 to 2 hours before serving. Makes about 12 ounces.
